species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 50°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 38–50 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 50°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 36–40 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Spotted bass
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 18–38 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 18–36 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
